data.title: Coalition: Air Defenses Intercept, Destroy Ballistic Missile Launched by Terrorist Houthi Militia toward Western Region
data.content:
Riyadh, November 22, 2026, SPA -- Official Spokesperson for the Coalition to Restore Legitimacy in Yemen Major General Turki Al-Malki stated that air defenses intercepted and destroyed a ballistic missile launched by the terrorist Houthi militia toward the western region.
    -- SPA
01:29 Local Time 22:29 GMT
